title.zh: 将伊莎贝拉省马格赛赛市镇北拉甘小学的名称变更为圣拉蒙小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Ragan Norte Elementary School in the Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Isabela, to San Ramon Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Ragan Norte Elementary School in the Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Isabela, to San Ramon Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Ragan Norte tại Thị trấn Magsaysay, Tỉnh Isabela thành Trường tiểu học San Ramon
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Ragan Norte ในเทศบาล Magsaysay, จังหวัด Isabela เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา San Ramon
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Ragan Norte di Kotamadya Magsaysay, Provinsi Isabela menjadi Sekolah Dasar San Ramon
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Ragan Norte di Perbandaran Magsaysay, Wilayah Isabela menjadi Sekolah Rendah San Ramon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2213_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Ragan Norte Elementary School in the Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Isabela, is hereby changed to San Ramon Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 16, 1959.
